in_marathi.name: Vedatman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge of the Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedatman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Veda', meaning 'knowledge'. The suffix 'atman' means 'soul'. Therefore, Vedatman translates to 'one who has knowledge of the Vedas and of the soul'.

in_bengali.name: Vedatman
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Knowledge of the Vedas
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vedatman একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Veda', meaning 'knowledge'. The suffix 'atman' means 'soul'. Therefore, Vedatman translates to 'one who has knowledge of the Vedas and of the soul'.
